nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Hmm. You actually made it up here. Good. I have been watching the Catacombs from the crystal ball -- the cultists have a ritual seal down there. If they complete the binding, whatever they have caged beneath that altar walks free. I need you to bring me the Ashen Seal before that happens.

choices.text: Tell me more about the seal.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: A ritual binder -- carved from the same stone as the altar itself. The cultists use it to anchor a summoning. Without the seal the ritual collapses. With it in the wrong hands... well. That is why I need it here, not there.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Good. The seal is deep in the Catacombs -- past the first hall, held in a chest the cultists guard jealously. You'll know it by the red glow. Do not attempt to use it yourself. Bring it directly to me.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: The Ashen Seal is still in the Catacombs. Find it -- it's guarded deep in the dungeon. Look for a chest with a red glow. Don't dawdle.

choices.text: What does it look like again?

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Red. Glowing. About the size of your fist. You will feel the wrongness of it before you see it. The cultists keep it behind their inner sanctum -- clear the hall and search the chests.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: You have it. I can feel it from here. Hand it over -- quickly, please, before it starts responding to the tower's aetheric field.

choices.text: Actually, can I hold onto it?

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Excellent. I'll seal it in the null-vault tonight. As for your reward -- this ring has been in my collection for two centuries. The warding runes are my own design. It will serve you better than it does a shelf.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: One more thing -- since you've proven yourself. Look up at the sky tonight. Count the stars in the Void Constellation. Four are missing. I believe their shards fell somewhere in the depths of this realm. Find them, and I can build something remarkable.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: No. Absolutely not. Bring it here immediately.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Where is the seal? You found it -- I could sense it briefly in the crystal -- but now I cannot. Did you lose it? Check your belongings carefully.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Four Void Shards, scattered across the deepest dungeon chambers. The things guarding them are not goblins. You need seasoned combat skills before I'd send you in. Come back when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Good -- you have the mettle for this. The four Void Shards are hidden in dungeon chests across the realm. The Ashwood Crypts, the Iron Depths, the Cultist Catacombs -- and one last shard in the deepest chest of the Stormcrag mountain caves. Each one will feel distinctly cold. Bring all four and I'll forge something you won't find anywhere else.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Excellent. Remember -- four shards, all of them. Half a constellation is useless to me.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Search the deepest chests in every dungeon -- the Ashwood Crypts, the Iron Depths, and the Cultist Catacombs. The shards are drawn to darkness.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Four shards. I can feel them from here -- the constellation hums again. Bring them to me. All four, now.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Perfect. Watch -- yes, there. The four stars are lit again. The Amulet of Stars is yours. I cannot explain what it will do in detail without three hours and a chalkboard. Wear it. You will understand.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Now -- while you are here. My Grimoire. The original one -- three hundred years of research. The cultists stole it during the siege and tore it into three fragments before I could stop them. The pages are scattered across the dungeons. I need them back. All three.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Good. The fragments will be in chests -- they are distinctive, you'll know them. The pages glow faintly even after all this time. Find all three and I'll teach you the Void Rune -- and give you something else besides.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Four shards. I can feel them from here -- the constellation hums again. Bring them to me. All four, now.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: You have found 0 of the three Grimoire Fragments. Search dungeon chests across the Ashwood Crypts, Iron Depths, and Cultist Catacombs. The pages still carry a faint aetheric signature -- they glow.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Everything. Three centuries of arcane theory, forty-seven original rune designs, the complete history of the Void Constellation event. And my chicken pie recipe, but that is confidential.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: All three fragments. I can feel the resonance even across the room. Hand them over -- carefully.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: There. Whole again. Centuries of work, intact. As promised -- the Void Rune is now available at the Spell Tome. And this staff has been waiting for someone worthy. It was made to amplify arcane intent. I find myself no longer needing it. You clearly do.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: You have found all three fragments -- but I sense you do not have them all on you. Check your inventory. Bring all three at once.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: The constellation burns bright again. Whatever is happening below that chapel -- the surges will slow, for a time. Though I suspect the calm won't last. Come back if you find anything else interesting.

choices.text: What happened to the Grimward kings?

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: The constellation burns bright again. Whatever is happening below that chapel -- the surges will slow, for a time. Though I suspect the calm won't last. Come back if you find anything else interesting.

choices.text: Tell me about the Void Shards.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Impressions. When something vast moved through the Whisperwood -- centuries ago -- it left residue. The Shadow Walkers are that residue, shaped by the ambient fear of the forest. They are not alive, exactly. But they are not not alive either.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: They were warned. I warned them personally, three times, in writing. They built their city on a convergence point -- aetheric lines crossing in the wrong configuration. When the cultists started digging beneath the chapel, the end was already written. I left before the last page.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Crystallised void-energy. They fell when four stars in the Constellation were extinguished -- something consumed them. The shards landed in the darkest places in the realm, drawn by resonance. You will feel cold near them.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Rune crafting? A worthy pursuit. Find the Spell Tome in this very tower -- it will guide you. Start with Arcane Dust before you attempt anything more ambitious. The tome is upstairs.

nodes.speaker: Aldermast
nodes.text: Pattern recognition, at the most fundamental level. The world has a grammar. Magic is learning to speak it. The runes are just mnemonic shortcuts -- training wheels for those who haven't memorised the conjugations yet. Give it time.

nodes.text: If you've got ore, I can smelt it. If you want gear, I've got stock. Just don't touch the cooling rack.

nodes.text: Grimward. A resident of Ashenveil.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Welcome to the Tarnished Flagon! Best -- and only -- inn in Ashenveil.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Bram Hollowtap. He's run the Tarnished Flagon for twenty years. He knows every rumour that passes through Ashenveil, and shares none of them for free.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Can't complain. Adventurers like yourself keep the coin flowing. Lost three regulars last month to the marshes though. Pour one out, as they say.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: A merchant came through yesterday. Said the Obsidian Depths are moving -- literally. The tunnels shift overnight. Strange magic, that.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: The Ashenveil Mead. Local honey, aged two seasons in oak barrels. Costs a bit more, but nothing else like it in the region. Worth every coin.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Two rooms upstairs, straw beds but clean linen. Sleep on either one -- no charge for resting. My policy: a rested adventurer is a living one.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Here's what I've got on tap tonight.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Still more where that came from.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: Kitchen's got a bit more too.

nodes.speaker: Bram
nodes.text: And last but not least.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Been stuck here three days waiting on a caravan that hasn't shown. Bram's ale is good at least. Too good, maybe.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Oswin. He travels between settlements buying and selling whatever fits in his pack. He's been waiting on a caravan for three days. He looks like he regrets stopping here.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: It's a rough place, but it's home. The market runs every day, the inn's warm, and the Grimward family keeps the forge burning. That's enough for most of us.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Quiet. Too quiet. The caravans from the west haven't come in two weeks. Something's blocking the pass, but nobody dares find out what.

nodes.speaker: Thessaly
nodes.text: I came to Ashenveil to find someone. Asked around. Nobody talks much. Maybe you know something -- person in a dark cloak, never shows their face?

nodes.speaker: Thessaly
nodes.text: Thessaly. She arrived in Ashenveil alone and hasn't said where from. She's been asking questions around town -- quietly. She seems to know more than she lets on.

nodes.text: Ahh, a customer! Come, come -- finest wares in the region.

choices.text: Where do you get your stock?

nodes.speaker: Dorin
nodes.text: Dorin. He's been trading these roads since before Ashenveil had proper walls. He knows where everything comes from -- and where it disappears to.

nodes.speaker: Dorin
nodes.text: I travel the zones -- dangerous work, but the margins are good. Found a chest of goblin-looted gear last week. Cleaned it up, marked it up, here we are.

nodes.speaker: Dorin
nodes.text: Not today. But if you bring me interesting materials -- ores, rare hides -- I'll give you a fair price. Better than leaving them to rot in your pack.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Before you take your first step into Ashenveil, you must choose your calling. Every path grants its own strengths and starting gear -- choose the one that calls to you.

choices.text: Ranger -- swift and deadly from the shadows
Prospector -- wealth waits beneath the stone

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: There are other callings still. Choose one, or see what remains.

choices.text: Shadowblade -- strikes once, and it is enough
Alchemist -- life-saving concoctions from raw ingredients
Farmhand -- knows the soil and the seasons

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: One calling remains, for those touched by the arcane.

choices.text: Arcane Mage -- the runes answered, and now they always will

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Warrior. A battle-hardened fighter who charges into the fray. Masters of brute force and iron defence.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Ranger. A wanderer of the wilds who hunts from the shadows. Swift and deadly, masters of the hunt.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Prospector. A hardy digger who knows every vein of ore in the rock. Wealth waits beneath the stone.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Shadowblade. A creature of darkness, lurking in fog and silence. They strike once -- and it is enough.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Alchemist. Part chef, part herbalist. Transforms raw ingredients into life-saving concoctions.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Farmhand. Raised on the land, calloused hands and a strong back. Knows the soil, the seasons, and which plants will kill you.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Arcane Mage. You came to the arcane through study, obsession, or accident. Either way, the runes answered -- and now they always will.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: And where do you come from? Your origin shapes you too.

choices.text: Highlander -- forged in the high crags
Exiled Noble -- coin, if little else

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: There are other origins still. Choose one, or see what remains.

choices.text: Street Orphan -- learned to take what you needed
Hedge Witch -- knows what grows and what heals

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: The last origins remain.

choices.text: Wandering Pilgrim -- has walked every road
Arcane Touched -- the runes noticed you too

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Valley Born. +5 Fishing, gentle start.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Highlander. +5 Mining, +2 Strength.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Exiled Noble. +30 starting gold, +2 Crafting.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Street Orphan. +5 Crafting, +2 Attack.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Veteran. +3 Attack & Defence.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Hedge Witch. +4 Farming, +4 Cooking.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Wandering Pilgrim. +3 Woodcutting, +3 Fishing.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Cursed Bloodline. +6 Hitpoints, starts in darkness.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Arcane Touched. +8 Magic, +2 Crafting.

nodes.speaker: A Voice Beyond the Veil
nodes.text: Your path is set. Take up your gear, and step into Ashenveil.
